<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs. Do not edit; source: contracts/definitions/memory.schema.json. Run task docs:ref:gen. -->

memory.yaml is the factory memory: short facts every run of the factory should know (ADR 0038 decision 6). It sits beside factory.yaml in the factory's definition. A run gets the entries in the Knowledge section of its prompt, unless its agent's builtins.read is off. Edit the facts in the Factory memory section of the web app's Definition page, with goal memory add and goal memory rm, or in the folder goal factory pull writes; Jonah's daily review proposes new ones. The file holds at most 8 KB and 50 entries (memory-too-big), and an entry's text at most 300 characters (memory-too-long).

The file is a list, and each entry has the fields below.

Fields are listed in the schema's order, each nested under the field that holds it. The fields under an array are those of each of its elements, and the fields under a map are those of each of its values.

## text

string, at least 1 character, required. One fact, at most 300 characters.

## from

array of string matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,38}[a-z0-9]#[1-9][0-9]*$`. The items the fact came from, as &lt;factory&gt;#&lt;number&gt;.

## added

string matching `^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$`, required. The date the fact was added, YYYY-MM-DD.
